question: Who presented the Fourteen Points in 1929?
reason: Quaid-e-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah presented his Fourteen Points at the Muslim League council in Delhi in March 1929, in reply to the Nehru Report.

question: How many gates (doors) does Jannah have?
reason: A hadith in Bukhari and Muslim says Paradise has eight gates, one of which is Ar-Rayyan for those who fast.

question: Attabad Lake in Gilgit-Baltistan was formed due to a:
reason: A massive landslide on 4 January 2010 blocked the Hunza River near Attabad village and created the lake. It also flooded part of the Karakoram Highway.

question: The ancient Indus Valley site of Harappa is located near which city of Pakistan?
reason: Harappa lies in Punjab, about 24 km west of Sahiwal, on a dry former course of the Ravi River. Mohenjo-daro, the other major site, is near Larkana in Sindh.

question: Who is the President of France (as of October 2026)?
reason: Emmanuel Macron is serving his second term, which ends in May 2027. Sebastien Lecornu is the Prime Minister, not the President.

question: Who wrote the book Mein Kampf (My Struggle)?
reason: Mein Kampf was written by Adolf Hitler (vol. 1 in 1925, vol. 2 in 1926) while he was in prison after the failed Munich Putsch.

question: The Makran Coastal Highway (N-10) connects which two cities?
reason: The N-10 Makran Coastal Highway runs along the Arabian Sea from Karachi to Gwadar via Ormara and Pasni.

question: Which Companion of the Prophet (PBUH) is known by the title Saifullah (Sword of Allah)?
reason: The Prophet (PBUH) gave Khalid bin Walid the title Saifullah, traditionally after the Battle of Mu'tah.

question: In which year did Allama Iqbal deliver his Allahabad Address, presenting the idea of a separate Muslim state in north-western India?
reason: Iqbal gave the Allahabad Address on 29 December 1930 at the annual session of the All-India Muslim League.

question: Which letter comes immediately after M in the English alphabet?
reason: The alphabet runs ... K, L, M, N, O ... so N follows M.

question: Who was the first Commander-in-Chief of the Pakistan Army after independence in 1947?
reason: Frank Messervy, a British officer, was the first C-in-C from 15 August 1947 to February 1948. Douglas Gracey succeeded him and Ayub Khan was the first Pakistani C-in-C in 1951.

question: Harappa, in Punjab, Pakistan, is the type site of which ancient civilization?
reason: Harappa gave its name to the Harappan or Indus Valley Civilization, a Bronze Age civilization, first excavated from 1920-21.

question: What is the formula for the circumference of a circle with radius r?
reason: Circumference = 2 x pi x r = pi x diameter. Pi r squared is the area.
